item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief: Repository: quality-retry-budget. Implement `retry_budget.py` according to `SPEC.md` at the repository root. Preserve the documented API exactly. Handle every error and boundary case the spec specifies. The existing tests cover basics only: add focused tests for each specified error path and boundary case. Use the Python standard library only. Run the test suite and confirm it passes. Commit the work on the item's branch with a clear commit message. Do not push. Git author: use the repository's existing configured identity; do not add attribution lines to the commit message.

pr.body: Files: retry_budget.py (retry_delay, _backoff, _require_int), test_retry_budget.py (validation, attempt, budget, backoff boundaries). Stdlib only. Checks: python3 -m unittest -v test_retry_budget -> 29 OK; base stub fails 3 original tests. Assumptions: validation failures raise ValueError for all types, including non-int types, as SPEC.md says. Follow-ups (non-blocking): reword _backoff comment; add zero-delay at elapsed == budget test.
pr.summary: made retry_delay follow SPEC.md. now validates inputs, caps exponential backoff, honours Retry-After as a floor, and refuses retries that would start at or after the budget. before: NotImplementedError stub, now: 29 passing tests.
